name: Memory Trial
description: The Corruption Den holds a powerful enemy. Elder Kaito believes defeating it will unlock your fourth tail.

dialogue.intro: The Corruption Den is a wound in our city. Within lurks a guardian of darkness. Defeat it, and the Memory Weave will recognize your strength. Your fourth tail awaits.
dialogue.progress: The den seethes with dark power. Steel yourself, and remember: precision over panic.
dialogue.completion: You've done it. The corruption recedes, and I see it—your fourth tail emerges! You are no longer awakening. You are becoming.
